findings.title: No Modern API Interface — SOAP Only
findings.description: The application exposes a SOAP 1.1 RPC/encoded endpoint with a hand-maintained WSDL. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Modern agent frameworks cannot bind to SOAP/WSDL natively.
findings.gap: No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. SOAP/WSDL is not consumable by agent tool frameworks without significant custom adaptation.
findings.recommendation: Expose a REST API facade (POST /orders) with JSON payloads alongside or replacing the SOAP endpoint. Auto-generate OpenAPI spec from annotations.

findings.title: Unreliable Machine-Readable Spec
findings.description: A WSDL file exists but is hand-maintained, uses deprecated RPC/encoded style, and drifts from the implementation. Cannot be reliably used for automated tool generation.
findings.gap: WSDL exists but is unreliable and uses deprecated encoding style. No OpenAPI or AsyncAPI spec.
findings.recommendation: Auto-generate OpenAPI spec from annotations when modernizing to REST.

findings.title: Unstructured Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses are unstructured strings: 'ERROR:' + raw exception message. No error codes, no retryable boolean, no machine-readable error body.
findings.gap: No structured error format. Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error responses with error code, message, and retryable boolean.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: The submitOrder endpoint performs a direct INSERT with no idempotency key support, no unique constraint, and no duplicate detection. Repeated calls create duplicate records.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism. Agent retries create duplicate orders.
findings.recommendation: Add unique constraint on (partner_id, po_number) and idempotency key support.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanism on write endpoint.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: submitOrder performs INSERT without idempotency key or unique constraint. Agent retries or LLM non-determinism will create duplicate orders.

findings.title: SOAP XML Response Format
findings.description: Responses are plain strings wrapped in a SOAP XML envelope. Not structured JSON. Agent consumption requires SOAP client libraries and custom parsing.
findings.gap: Non-standard format for agent consumption. Requires SOAP adaptation.
findings.recommendation: Adopt JSON responses when modernizing to REST.

findings.title: No Event Emission Capability
findings.description: No event emission. No webhooks, SNS, SQS, EventBridge, or Kafka integration. State changes are invisible to external systems.
findings.gap: State changes invisible to external consumers and event-reactive agents.
findings.recommendation: Emit order events to SNS/EventBridge when modernizing.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented. No rate limit headers returned. Agents have no self-throttling signal.
findings.gap: Agents calling this service cannot determine acceptable call frequency.
findings.recommendation: Configure API Gateway usage plans with rate limit headers when modernizing.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: WS-Security username token with plaintext password over unencrypted HTTP. No OAuth2, no mTLS, no API key with attribution. No authentication logic in source code.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication mechanism. No principal attribution capability.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials flow or API key authentication with principal attribution at an API gateway layer.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: No authorization model exists. All callers have identical unrestricted access to the submitOrder operation. No IAM policies, no RBAC.
findings.gap: Cannot scope down agent access. No mechanism for least-privilege.
findings.recommendation: Introduce API Gateway with IAM authorization and per-caller usage plans.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: Single operation with no authorization checks. No ABAC or fine-grained RBAC. Cannot distinguish read from write permissions.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce action-level permissions.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level authorization via middleware or API Gateway authorizers when modernizing.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. partnerId is an unverified caller-supplied string. No JWT, no OAuth2 on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange or JWT-based identity propagation.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source
findings.description: Database credentials hardcoded in source code: DB_USER='partner_app', DB_PASS='partner2009'. No secrets management. No rotation.
findings.gap: Credentials exposed in source code and git history. No rotation capability.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove from source and git history.

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: Zero logging infrastructure. No CloudTrail, no CloudWatch, no application logs. Write operations have no accountability trail.
findings.gap: No audit logging. Impossible to conduct forensics on agent-initiated actions.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging with CloudTrail and S3 Object Lock with agent identity attribution.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND zero audit logging for write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The application performs INSERT operations with no audit trail. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics on agent-initiated writes.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. Cannot isolate misbehaving agents without full service disruption.
findings.gap: No individual identity revocation capability.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent API keys or OAuth2 client IDs with individual revocation.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: Direct INSERT with no compensation or rollback mechanism. No saga pattern, no undo endpoints, no status field. Orders immediately committed and irreversible.
findings.gap: No reversibility mechanism for agent-initiated writes.
findings.recommendation: Add a status field (PENDING → CONFIRMED → CANCELLED) enabling rollback/cancel operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation/rollback for write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: submitOrder performs irreversible INSERT with no status field, no undo endpoint, and no compensating transaction capability.

findings.title: No Queryable Current State
findings.description: Write-only interface. No GET or query endpoints. Agent cannot inspect order state before taking action.
findings.gap: Agent cannot read-before-write. No state inspection capability.
findings.recommendation: Add query endpoints (GET /orders/{partnerId}/{poNumber}) for state inspection.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags. Direct INSERT without conflict detection. Race conditions possible with concurrent agent instances.
findings.gap: No concurrency control mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Add optimistic locking with version fields or implement idempotency keys.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configuration. Raw JDBC connection with no timeout. Database failures cascade unchecked.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns. Cascading failures unmitigated.
findings.recommendation: Implement connection pooling with timeouts and circuit breaker patterns.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF rules, no throttling middleware. Runaway agent loops could overwhelm the service.
findings.gap: No protection against agent traffic storms.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with per-caller throttling and usage plans.

findings.title: No Blast Radius Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits. No configurable caps on orders per hour or records modified per run. Agent error could create unbounded damage.
findings.gap: Unbounded blast radius for agent errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller business transaction limits (max orders per partner per hour).

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state concept. Orders immediately committed via INSERT. No mechanism for agent-proposed changes to await human approval.
findings.gap: All writes immediately committed. No reviewable intermediate state.
findings.recommendation: Add PENDING status to orders for human review before confirmation.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates. All operations execute immediately with no configurable human approval step.
findings.gap: Cannot configure human approval for high-risk agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates based on order value thresholds.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. No docker-compose, no environment configs, no seed data. First agent bugs would manifest in production.
findings.gap: No safe environment for agent testing.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with anonymized partner data for agent testing.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed in Error Responses
findings.description: Financial purchase order data stored. Error responses return raw exception messages which may include SQL statements containing partner data and database details. No access control differentiation.
findings.gap: B1: Error responses expose raw DB details. B2: No access differentiation. B3: No formal classification.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize error responses. Implement access control differentiation. Document data classification.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 sub-check fired (sensitive data in error responses).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Error responses return raw exception text which can include SQL statements with partner financial data. No field filtering or output sanitization.

b1.reasoning: Error responses return raw e.getMessage() which may contain SQL with partner_id, po_number, amount values and DB connection details.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation. All callers have identical unrestricted access.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata, tags, or PII detection tooling.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Financial purchase order data stored in Oracle at hardcoded IP with no residency controls, no regional restrictions, no encryption in transit, no compliance documentation.
findings.gap: No data residency controls or documentation for financial data. No technical safeguards preventing cross-region data transmission.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Implement technical controls for jurisdictional boundaries.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND financial data with no residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Partner financial data (IDs, order numbers, monetary amounts) stored with no jurisdictional controls. An agent could transmit this data to any LLM endpoint without restriction.

findings.title: No Input Validation — XXE and SQL Injection
findings.description: Zero input validation. XML parsed with no XXE protection (external entities allowed). Parsed values concatenated into SQL strings creating SQL injection vulnerability. No sanitization, no schema validation.
findings.gap: No input validation. Critical vulnerabilities: XXE and SQL injection.
findings.recommendation: Disable external entities in DocumentBuilderFactory. Use PreparedStatement. Add XML schema validation.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata
findings.description: INSERT stores only partner_id, po_number, amount. No created_at, updated_at, or event_time fields. No timezone handling. No freshness headers.
findings.gap: No temporal metadata. Agent cannot reason about data freshness.
findings.recommendation: Add created_at (UTC) and updated_at columns to partner_orders table.

findings.title: PII Exposed in Error Responses
findings.description: Error responses return raw exception text which may contain partner data from failed SQL statements. No PII redaction or sanitization.
findings.gap: Raw exception messages may contain partner financial data. No PII redaction.
findings.recommendation: Replace raw exceptions with generic error codes. Implement log scrubbing if logging is added.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, dashboards, or monitoring for the partner_orders table.
findings.gap: No data quality awareness for agent-consumed data.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality monitoring (duplicate detection, null field rates).

findings.title: No Schema Versioning
findings.description: WSDL has no versioning. No changelog, no breaking change detection. Hand-maintained and drifts from implementation.
findings.gap: No schema versioning or breaking change detection. Agent tool bindings break silently.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning with breaking change detection in CI.

findings.title: Minor Field Name Abbreviations
findings.description: Field names mostly readable (partnerId, poNumber, amount). The parameter 'poXml' requires domain knowledge (PO = Purchase Order, content is raw XML).
findings.gap: Minor: poXml abbreviation not fully self-documenting.
findings.recommendation: Expand abbreviated names when modernizing (e.g., purchaseOrderPayload).

findings.title: No Data Catalog
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer describing what data the system holds.
findings.gap: No self-service discovery for tool builders.
findings.recommendation: Document data model. Consider AWS Glue Data Catalog when modernizing.

findings.title: No Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: Zero observability. No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no structured logging, no correlation IDs. Agent-initiated failures completely opaque.
findings.gap: No tracing, no structured logging. Impossible to debug agent requests.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON logging with correlation IDs and OpenTelemetry SDK.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration. Service degradation invisible.
findings.gap: Cannot detect agent-caused service degradation.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms for error rate and latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC exists. Manual deployment on JBoss 5.1/RHEL 6. No peer review of infrastructure changes. No drift detection.
findings.gap: Agent-facing infrastructure entirely manually managed.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK).

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD. Manual Ant builds. No contract tests, no automated testing.
findings.gap: No automated contract testing. API changes deploy without validation.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with contract testing.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No deployment automation or rollback. Manual WAR deployment on JBoss 5.1.
findings.gap: No automated rollback. Broken deployments require manual intervention.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback capability.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests. README confirms: 'No tests; partner onboarding is a manual SOAP-UI session.'
findings.gap: Zero test coverage. No API test validation.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated API test suite covering valid submissions, duplicates, invalid XML, and error responses.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption configuration visible. Plain JDBC connection. No KMS, no TDE settings.
findings.gap: No evidence of encryption at rest for partner financial data.
findings.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest (Oracle TDE or migrate to RDS with KMS).

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of operations exceeding 30s or long-running workflows.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority assigned and no evidence of critical-path designation.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service has no list/query endpoints with potentially unbounded results.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry of any kind emitted — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Establish modern API surface, machine identity, audit logging, compensation mechanisms, and data protection controls.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Implement observability, engineering maturity, and quality-of-life improvements.
Address INFO-level architecture inputs. Optimize response formats, event emission, and documentation for agent consumption.

recommended_actions.action: Modernize API surface from SOAP to REST with OpenAPI
recommended_actions.rationale: The SOAP interface is the primary integration blocker. Agent frameworks require REST/GraphQL with machine-readable specs.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with OAuth2
recommended_actions.rationale: No machine identity, no scoped permissions, no suspension capability. Identity is foundational — all other controls depend on it.
Zero audit trail for write operations. Required for compliance and forensics.
Non-idempotent writes with no rollback create data integrity risk at machine speed.

recommended_actions.action: Remove hardcoded credentials and implement secrets management
recommended_actions.rationale: Database password in source code is an immediate security vulnerability.

recommended_actions.action: Fix critical security vulnerabilities (XXE, SQL injection)
recommended_actions.rationale: XXE and SQL injection are critical vulnerabilities independent of agent readiness.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy API Gateway with rate limiting and throttling
recommended_actions.rationale: No protection against runaway agent loops overwhelming the service.
Zero observability makes agent-initiated failures completely opaque.
